description: On the bed in front of you there’s a small stack of colorful cloths, with a yellow cloth on top and blue and green cloths nearby. The left hand reaches to the stack and lifts the yellow cloth while the right hand comes in to help, making it a two-hand object as they unfold it and lay it flat to the right; then both hands lift a blue cloth, open it up, and place it over the yellow, before the left hand picks up a folded green cloth, opens it, and sets it on top while the right hand smooths and aligns the edges.
